# Connected Mate

> Connected Mate is a French ecosystem founded in 2018 by Alexandre Cormeraie and PPC, combining AI and innovation keynotes, a podcast with 100+ episodes, privacy-first iOS and macOS apps (Better Dictate, Pock, Notetaker AI, Dys Keyboard), and white-label AI consulting. Connected Mate SAS is based in Paris (74 avenue du General Leclerc, 75014).

Important facts at a glance:

- Legal entity: Connected Mate SAS, Paris, France
- Founders: Alexandre Cormeraie (co-founder, AI keynote speaker) and PPC (co-founder)
- Founded: 2018
- Contact: alex.connectedmate@gmail.com / WhatsApp +33 7 82 15 04 38
- Languages: French, English
- Clients include: INSEAD, CEDEP, CFAO, Nexus Automotive International, Tech Rocks, AEF info

## Applications

- [Better Dictate (FR)](https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/better-dictate.html): on-device voice dictation for macOS, powered by Whisper, 100% offline
- [Better Dictate (EN)](https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/en/better-dictate.html): English product page
- [Notetaker AI (FR)](https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/notetaker-ai.html): meeting transcription and note-taking assistant for iOS
- [Notetaker AI (EN)](https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/en/notetaker-ai.html): English product page
- [Pock (FR)](https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/pock.html): Touch Bar customization for MacBook Pro
- [Pock (EN)](https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/en/pock.html): English product page
- [Dys Keyboard (FR)](https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/dys-keyboard.html): the iOS keyboard everyone should have had from day one. Bigger keys, color-coded zones that guide the eye and ease the memory. Built for dyslexia, dysorthographia, dyspraxia, and great for kids, teens, adults and seniors alike. On-device only
- [Dys Keyboard (EN)](https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/en/dys-keyboard.html): English product page
